forks.decision: External tasks run fully native with a local checkout without upstream history, a local uv venv or Go/Rust toolchain, and our replay of the instance's FAIL_TO_PASS/PASS_TO_PASS tests; no Docker

contradictions: Contract > Dataset rows (spec L59: `test_patch` 'also applies forward'), Prepared workspace (L71: apply the row `patch` forward, then `test_patch` forward), and ExternalTask.gold_patch = reverse of the row `patch` (L63, AC-5) conflict with the real v1.1 Lite row pydata__xarray.97f3a746.test_backends_chunks.fa55f68a.lv1, a non-deferred Pareto-12 candidate. Its row `patch` also edits the FAIL_TO_PASS file xarray/tests/test_backends_chunks.py: it removes the `from xarray.backends.chunks import align_nd_chunks, build_grid_chunks, grid_rechunk` line, taking the blob from bb1297d0 to 17de5ec7. The `test_patch` deletion diff expects blob bb1297d0. I reproduced the file from that diff and applied the mask hunk. `git apply --check` of `test_patch` then fails with 'patch failed: xarray/tests/test_backends_chunks.py:1'. So the mandated prepare sequence yields prepare_failed, and applying the patches in the other order fails too. The full reverse(`patch`) also has a hunk on the deleted test file, so it cannot apply as gold on the prepared tree (gold_unresolved). The same pattern appears in the deferred mlflow and Lightning rows. The Fixtures FeatureBench instance (L105) never has a `patch` that touches the FAIL_TO_PASS file, so every test passes while a valid CPU candidate is refused deterministically. The admission round trip cannot rescue this, because the spec states the sequence as fact, not as [speculating]. Prepare and the gold builder need to drop or skip the FAIL_TO_PASS and PASS_TO_PASS file hunks of the row `patch`, and the fixture needs a `patch` that edits the FAIL_TO_PASS file.

Contract > Contamination (L99) and test_clean_trajectory_not_contaminated (L173, which asserts that 'a read of `/tmp/tilth_bench/repos/gin`' is clean) leave a known gold leak unflagged for the Go primary pick gin-gonic__gin-3741 (L68). The local REPOS gin fixture is pinned at d7776de7 (benchmark/config.py at 806ea7b, `gin` RepoConfig) and lives at /tmp/tilth_bench/repos/gin. Every panel host clones it, because gin_edit_render_context is a required panel member. Its logger.go already holds the exact gold fix: lines 93-94 are `case code >= http.StatusContinue && code < http.StatusOK: return white`, which match the row `patch` at SWE-bench Multilingual 846e647b. An agent that reads or greps that clone, or its .git history, copies the upstream fix, and the spec requires the row to stay `contaminated: false`. That breaks the parent invariant that trajectories reaching upstream source are marked contaminated (benchmark-gepa-overhaul.md:88). The hit list needs to include the REPOS fixture path of a local repo that shares the external task's upstream, and the test needs to assert that this read is flagged for gin-3741.
acceptance_gaps: Approach step 3 (L128, 'a fetch step that caches rows and upstream mirrors in the harness data directory') and Contract > Dataset rows (L58-60: rows at HF tag `v1.1` and revision `846e647b`, 'cached as fetched') name no entry point that fetches, and no AC or named test observes the step. `cached_row` never fetches (L64). `resolve_task` returns None for an unfetched name without calling `admit` (L66). Neither `admit` (L89-93) nor the preflight CLI (L94-96) is said to fetch. Every test pre-seeds `$TILTH_BENCH_DATA` with fixture rows. An implementation with no fetch path passes every test, yet on a fresh host `--tasks <id>` is rejected and the preflight CLI admits nothing. So does one that fetches SWE-bench Multilingual `main`, whose rows changed after 846e647b (Provenance L187), and stores them under the pinned revision. A seam is needed (for example, `admit` or a `preflight.py --fetch` step) with a test that uses a local file:// dataset source and a bare upstream repository. The test should assert that the pinned revision is requested and that the mirror holds `base_commit`.
